ratios.facility: Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement
ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026 , the Company was in compliance with all covenants, including the specified total consolidated net leverage ratio range of 4.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: Only the maximum (4.00x) and a compliance statement are disclosed; no actual ratio given. No borrowings were outstanding under the $600.0 million revolver at September 30, 2026. The definition nets the lesser of unrestricted cash and 125% of adjusted consolidated EBITDA.
